properties.NAME: HAWAII
properties.CHANGE: HAWAII created by the Territory of Hawaii from EAST HAWAII and WEST HAWAII, all other islands lying within three nautical miles of the shores thereof, and the waters adjacent thereto; EAST HAWAII, and WEST HAWAII eliminated.
properties.CITATION: (Hawaii Terr. Laws 1905, reg. sess., act 39, ch. 1/p. 45)
